tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bka' brgyud 'bri gung pa lugs kyi skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// mgon med 'gro la rjes chags thugs bskyed kyis// tshogs gnyis mthar son lnga bdo'i 'gro ba'i nang*// bcu gnyis mdzad pa ston mdzad shākya'i rgyal// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rgyal tshab thugs rje'i dbang phyug ma pham mgon// sa gsum mnga' bdag 'phags pa thogs med zhabs// 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i khyu mchog dbyig gi gnyen// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rab dga'i sa thob 'phags pa grol sde'i zhabs// byams pas byin rlabs btsun pa rnam grol sde// lung rtogs yon tan phun tshogs mchog gi sde// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzungs dul ba'i sde// rgyal yum sher phyin don gzigs rnam snang mdzad// lung rig smra ba'i nyi ma seng ge bzang*// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rgyal ba'i man ngag kun 'dzin rin chen bzang*// bdag gzhan mnyam rje'i thugs mnga' rin chen sde// mtha' 'khob bstan pa'i sgron me gser gling pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// stobs bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal ba zas gtsang sras// rgyal kun yab gyur ye shes me long mtshan// rgyal bas lung bstan 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// dbu ma'i lam bzang gsal mdzad 'phags pa lha// theg mchog bstan pa'i rtsa lag sgra gcan 'dzin// lta ngan 'joms mdzad ra hu la mi tra// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// phyogs las rnam rgyal klu yi bshes gnyen zhabs// bdag lta'i ri bo 'jig mdzad dge 'dun srung*// 'jigs bral sangs rgyas bskyangs dang pad+ma'i blo// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// lnga brgya'i gtsug nor dpal ldan zla ba grags// 'phags yul pan chen rig pa'i khu byug zhabs// rten 'brel mngon gyur a wa dhu ti pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// sangs rgyas gnyis pa dpal ldan mar me mdzad// bka' gdams bstan pa'i mes po 'brom ston rje// dri med blo gros mchog ldan rin chen gsal// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rab 'byams gzhung lugs kun mkhyen yon tan grags// 'jigs med chos kyi rgyal po dol ba'i mtshan// byang chub sems dpa' chen po chos skyab bzang*// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// snang mtha'i zhal skyin rdo rje seng ge dang*// stong nyid snying rje thugs chud byang chub dpal// rgyal ba'i sras po spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// gzhan phan 'gro don mthar phyin gnyug rum pa// stong nyid nam mkha'i rang bzhin gzhon nu 'od// ting 'dzin mchog ldan a mes byang rin la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// dpal ldan dgon pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan dang*// bden gnyis gnas lugs don gzigs rgya yon bdag

/kun bzang rnam 'phrul sne zur ye shes 'bar// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// chos brgyad kun spangs blo gros dbang phyug dang*// thub pa'i brtul zhugs dri med lho pa rje// shes phyin rgyas mdzad byang chub ye shes la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// dwags brgyud bstan pa'i srol 'byed bsod nams mtshan// 'khor ba 'jig sprul khyab dag rdo rje rgyal// dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus 'bri gung pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// yid srub zil gnon spyan snga grags 'byung zhabs// til brdung grub pa'i dpa' bo rdo rje grags// 'phags chen snying rje'i gter gyur thog kha pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag brgyud byin gyis rlobs// byang chub sems 'byongs rgyal sras grags bsod pa// mnga' bsnun mchog gi rnam rol rdor rin rje// mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i myu gu nyer brgyud pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// kun gzigs bla ma 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal// grub brnyes bye ba'i gtsug nor sman sgom zhabs// don brgyud bstan pa'i sgron me la phyi ba// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// chos sku mngon gyur rin chen chos kyi dbang*// mkhyen rtogs yon tan dpal mnga' grags pa 'byung*// gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i gter chen kun rgyal ba// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// brtson 'grus rmad byung rin chen rdo rje dang*// spros bral don gzigs dbang phyug bsod nams zhabs// grub mchog spyan snga grags pa shes rab mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// mang thos yon tan mchog mnga' tshul khrims rgyal// zung 'jug mchog brnyes grags pa rdo rje dang*// sgrub pa mthar phyin kun mkhyen blo gros bzang*// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// thub bstan kun gsal mkhan chen brag lcog pa// 'gro mgon thugs sprul bsod nams bkra shis mtshan// 'bri bstan sgron me rje btsun rat+na la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i gtsug rgyan rin chen dpal// tshul khrims rnam dag yongs 'dzin sangs rgyas mtshan// 'jam dpal zhi khro mchog grub dbur smyon rje// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// pad+ma'i lung zin 'phrin las rnam par rgyal// ngag gi dbang phyug kun mkhyen bzang po'i sde// bshad sgrub mdzes nor 'jam dbyangs don kun grub// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// zla med rgyal ba'i sras po mgar sprul rje// rgyal bstan mdzod 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma'i zhabs// brtse chen mi yi rnam rol pad+ma'i mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// gzhan phan 'phrin las lhun grub chos rgyan zhabs// legs sbyar sgra skad mngon mkhyen khri chen rje// pad dkar 'chang sprul 'dren mchog thugs rje'i mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// mthong thos dran grol dkon mchog chos skyabs dpal// gsum ldan rje btsun dharma s+ya ma ti// bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen zhi ba'i blo gros mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// dran pa tsam gyis srid pa'i gdung 'phrog cing*// dad pas bsnyen na mchog gi dngos grub kyang*// bde blag stsol mdzad rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// sgrub pa'i rten mchog rnyed dka'i dal 'byor lus// glo bur rkyen gyis nam 'chi cha med pa'i// mi rtag rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal drag pos yid skyo nas// mngon mtho'i bde ba rab tu sgrub pa'i phyir// dge sdig dkar nag lam la yid ches nas// blang dor tshul bzhin sgrub par byin gyis rlobs// srid pa'i bde ba'ang sdug bsngal rang bzhin du// shes nas zhi bde'i go 'phang 'tshol ba'i slad// 'khor ba'i las la snying nas rgyab phyogs shing*// thar pa'i lam bzang sgrub par byin gyis rlobs// rang gi bde sdug brtags pas mar gyur gyi// khams gsum 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma bzod par// tshad med byams dang snying rje 'byongs pa dang*// byang chub sems mchog skye bar byin gyis rlobs// dpag med 'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas phyir// brtson pa drag pos smon 'jug sems bskyed kyi// bslab bya nyams pa med par bya dka' ba'i// rgyal sras lam la slob par byin gyis rlobs// pha rol phyin pa'i lam gyis sa bcu dag

/rab bgrod rdzogs pa'i byang chub brnyes gyur nas// ma lus 'gro ba bde blag 'dren pa yi// 'phrin las lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs// deng nas bzung te skye ba kun tu bdag /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i chu bo yongs 'dus pa'i// mnyam med dwags po'i ring lugs rgya mtsho las// thos bsam sgom pa'i nor bu len gyur cig /de ltar 'phags pa thogs med dang klu sgrub las brgyud pa'i shing rta chen po gnyis kyi man ngag gi sgom rim ches mang yang*/ 'dir mnyam med dwags po dang 'gro mgon phag grus mdzad pa'i lam rim dang bstan rim gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol ba 'debs dngos gzhi spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis rnam rgyal sogs dam pa gong ma gsung la dbu ma'i bla brgyud kyi skabs 'phags yul chos 'byung nas bshad pa'i ring brgyud de nyid sngon chad bod yul 'dir cher ma grags pas ngo mtshar bar bsams gtso bor ston cing*// bka' gdams gzhung pa dang gdams ngag pa sogs kyi brgyud pa'i khyad par mang zhig tshang bar byas pa 'di yang bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres kyi bstan pa'i rgyun yar rgyas kyi ched du dmigs nas 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi blo gros kyis yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ya gya grub pa'i bsti gnas 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra bar sbyar ba'o/// /
